subject: POC action plan + scoring rubric — next steps
messages:
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <pshah@healthsync.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-07T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: POC action plan + scoring rubric — next steps

Hi Priya — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have the same frame for the POC: 

Call recap
- Primary goal: validate Redwood inference in HealthSync triage pipeline (document classification + suggested replies) under expected production mix.
- Target pages: 20k/day equivalent traffic, with peak spikes up to 45k tokens/minute.
- Decision criteria: precision/recall on triage labels, latency P95 < 350ms, and non-regression on top-line customer satisfaction metric provided by you.

Proposed POC structure (Redwood-managed):
1) Shadow run (online) — 3 business days: Redwood mirrors inference on live writes (no user-facing changes) to collect latency, output distribution, and real-time mismatches.
2) Offline eval — 5 business days: run historical dataset through candidate models and apply scoring rubric to compare quality vs baseline.
3) Acceptance gates: quality score >= 0.78 (weighted rubric below), latency P95 < 350ms, and no sensitive-data leakage in KV logs.

Scoring rubric (high level) — attached summary and editable sheet in follow-up:
- Label accuracy (40%)
- False positive cost (25%)
- Reply relevance (20%)
- Safety / PII flag rate (15%)

Owners and deliverables
- Redwood: run shadow infra, collect logs, run offline eval, deliver scoring report and a recommended model variant. (Owner: Rohan)
- HealthSync: provide historical dataset + evaluation subset (2 engineers), confirm acceptance thresholds (Owner: Priya).
- Success review: 1-hour readout with stakeholders + signoff.

Timeline (tentative)
- Data export & access: by EOD Wed (10/09)
- Shadow run: Thu–Mon (10/10–10/13)
- Offline eval & scoring: Tue–Mon (10/14–10/20)
- Readout & decision: Tue (10/21)

Next steps (immediate)
1) Please confirm dataset availability and who from HealthSync will own the export.
2) Approve the proposed timeline or suggest alternative windows.
3) I attached the POC charter we referenced — see "poc-charter-v1.pdf".

Thanks — I can jump on a 15-minute call if you want to tweak the acceptance gates.

—
Rohan Mehta
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: poc-charter-v1.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)]

Subject: Re: POC action plan + scoring rubric — next steps

Thanks Rohan — useful summary. A few quick notes from our side: 

- Data: we can produce a 30-day historical export and a 5k-row labeled subset for the offline eval. I'll ask engineering to start the export; owner will be Tom Nguyen (cc'd).
- Timeline: prefer starting shadow the week of 10/14 rather than 10/10 — we have a scheduled maintenance on 10/11 that could complicate traffic mirroring. Can Redwood shift by 3 business days?
- Acceptance: the quality threshold sounds reasonable, but we need to convert the weighted rubric into absolute pass/fail thresholds per metric (e.g., label accuracy >= 0.80 OR combined score >= 0.78). Can you provide that table?

Also attaching our internal assessment template to show what fields we expect in the scoring CSV.

Next steps on our side:
- I'll confirm the export owner and ETA by EOD tomorrow.
- Circling in Tom for any infrastructure questions.

Appreciate the cadence — talk soon.

Best,
Priya
Head of Product Ops
HealthSync

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <pshah@healthsync.com>
Date: 2026-10-08T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC action plan + scoring rubric — next steps

Following up on Priya's request to shift the shadow start and to make the rubric absolute. My suggested adjustments below — I also attached an editable CSV for the rubric.

1) Timeline shift
- New proposal: Shadow run Mon–Wed (10/19–10/21), offline eval Thu–Wed (10/22–10/28), readout Thu 10/29. This gives us time to ingest the export and sanity-check pipelines.

2) Absolute thresholds (proposed)
- Label accuracy >= 0.80 (pass)
- False positive rate <= 6% (pass)
- Reply relevance (human-eval avg) >= 3.7 / 5 (pass)
- Safety / PII flags <= 0.3% (pass)
- Combined weighted score >= 0.78 (pass)

3) Eval orchestration notes
- Shadow approach: run live traffic mirror with anonymization for PII, capture model outputs and latency; no user-facing changes. We'll provide a daily digest with key deltas.
- Offline eval: use your labeled subset + stratified samples from the historical export. We'll run top-3 candidate model variants and produce per-variant scorecards.

4) Owners
- Infra & shadow run: Marissa (setup) + Infra SRE (tbd)
- Offline eval & scoring: Karthik (lead) + Data Science (run scripts)
- Readout & recommendation: Rohan (present)

Can Karthik and Rohan confirm the infra window and that Redwood will grit through the anonymization step (we will not keep raw PII logs)?

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success — Trials
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: eval-rubric-v2.csv (CSV, 18KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: POC action plan + scoring rubric — next steps

Thanks — confirming from my side. A few clarifications and the operational checklist I will own: 

- Shadow start: we can shift to 10/19 as Marissa suggested. Please confirm by Fri 10/09 so we can lock SRE schedule.
- Anonymization: Redwood will run a deterministic PII scrub on mirrored payloads. We will not persist raw PII; scrubbed outputs + token-level latency will be stored for 90 days per our standard trial data retention policy. (If HealthSync needs a shorter window we can adjust.)
- Eval artifacts I will produce:
  * Per-variant scorecard CSV (label metrics, FP/FN counts, relevance human-review samples)
  * Latency and cost breakdown (per-token and projected monthly ops)
  * Failure-mode notes (top 10 edge cases)

Operational checklist (items I'll track in our trial Jira):
- [ ] HealthSync export received and validated (owner: Tom)
- [ ] Anonymization pipeline config reviewed (owner: Marissa)
- [ ] Shadow infra scheduled and SRE booked (owner: Marissa)
- [ ] Offline eval scripts parameterized with your label schema (owner: Karthik)
- [ ] Readout invite + stakeholder list (owner: Rohan)

Priya — if that matches what you expect, I'll create the Jira ticket today and drop a link here. Otherwise flag any missing items.
